title: Backup, restore and reconciliation
brief: Choose and verify a restorable history, then reconcile the valid work excluded by recovery.
outcomes: Match recovery-point and recovery-time needs to a backup chain
Restore and reconcile later or external effects against a closed source history
entry: Crash recovery, history and transaction boundaries.

heading.title: A recovery objective
heading.brief: Define acceptable loss and time to service for the shop; compare logical copies, physical backups and continuous history with independent failure domains.

heading.title: A complete chain
heading.brief: Connect base state, logs or incrementals, credentials and keys; deliberately remove a needed link and explain the resulting recovery limit.

heading.title: A verified target
heading.brief: Use the proposed mistake at 11:00 and a later valid order; select the recovery target and verify data and application invariants before traffic.

nested_article.title: Restoring PostgreSQL to a recovery target
nested_article.brief: Restore a PostgreSQL cluster to a verified target and account for the work outside that history.
outcomes: Build and test a base-backup and archived-WAL chain
Verify a target and reconcile later valid effects safely
nested_article.entry: General backup reasoning and PostgreSQL WAL.

heading.title: Reconciliation after restore
heading.brief: Fence the earlier write authority and settle in-flight or uncertain requests before final enumeration of excluded valid work. Recover those orders and check provider effects by stable identity, preventing double stock consumption; keep the source fenced through final invariant checks and write-authority handover.

nested_article.title: CockroachDB backup and recovery
nested_article.brief: Restore a CockroachDB history and reconcile a later valid booking without consuming capacity twice.
outcomes: Validate full/incremental backup coverage and restore scope
Close source writes and reconcile booking identity, capacity and external effects
nested_article.entry: General recovery and fenced reconciliation, the class booking invariant and CockroachDB transactions.
